author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
“You can use this with Micro.blog, Known or any other Micropub compatible server” This is a perfect way to put it for the average user. Though I might replace server with app or service.

I didn't truly understand until we were discussing Indigenous on IRC. In many ways, though I get this is limiting, MicroPub is the "Write" feature and MicroSub is the "Read" feature of #indieweb

I am excited to play around and launch Aperture and play.
